version_dispatch: The GSP type identifies v1. Unsupported future versions require a distinct type.

accepted.0: RSSI and SNR unsupported; no numeric fields exist

validation: Exact payload length 3+air_length, known backend and zero flags required.
metrics: Live state, raw/parsed logs and exports carry None. Do not synthesize numeric measurements.
legacy: SX uses existing type2 with unchanged signed metrics and bytes. Old clients safely ignore type5 and cannot display NRF AIR data; functional backward compatibility is not claimed.
business: M0 bytes, CMD/ACK and GSP AIR_TX/ACK unchanged. No hardware ACK is a business ACK.
